scope: Optional structured decisions in existing canonical Markdown owners; explicit identity updates and lifecycle-aware route references. No general ranking optimization.
baseline: Working tree after routing-contract fixes, snapshotted before decision support

hybrid.interpretation: Independent provider responses do not establish an accuracy gain. The corpus has no structured decision blocks.

covers: Required rationale, evidence and explicit status
Settled claim preservation, successor chains and cycles
Custom configured sources and no implicit bootstrap
Write to reindex to fresh-session retrieval
Lexical, hybrid, explicit and semantic-only status exposure
Restored decision state and range without scan or network
Invalid-source diagnostics and nonzero CLI exit
Legacy append cannot corrupt decision blocks

research.discoveryFailure: smart-search doctor: HTTP 429 on main search; fetch available

limitations: No automatic semantic conflict detection or migration of existing prose.
Decision identity and supersession are scoped to one owner.
Status is exposed for agent judgment; accepted-first intent ranking is not implemented.
Evidence presence and block shape cannot prove truth or downstream model compliance.
Live AI behavior across Codex/Claude sessions, installation and publication were not tested.
The 100-query benchmark measures file retrieval on one unannotated project, not decision answer accuracy.
